text.content:
A private clinic and teahouse behind a white wall with a rabbit on the gate.

Region: Off Jig-Jig Street, Japantown
Controlled by: The Usagi
The feel of it: Quiet, immaculate, and avoided by every Tyger Claw
Danger: SC 8: the Usagi, Hardened Medium

The Usagi family's home and surgery, in the middle of Claw territory. Its surgeons are some of the best in the city and work on outsiders for a price and a favor. Tsukimi conversions are for family only.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.04, 09
